gm: Pulls the strings behind every twist of fate.
The architect of peril and possibility.
Their silence is more dangerous than any roar.
Crafts legends from chaos and dice.
Laughs in riddles, plots in layers.
Puppeteer of destiny, doom, and drama.
Holds the world in the palm of their hand.
The voice of gods, monsters, and the wind.
Shapes nightmares into maps and riddles.
Both enemy and ally, always watching.
Sows mystery with every word spoken.
Builds empires to burn them down again.
Their whim is law, their dice the storm.
Paints darkness with a flick of the tongue.
Knows your next move before you roll it.
They are the shadow that writes your fate.
person: A keeper of forgotten oaths and ancient truths.
Wanders the wilds with eyes like storm clouds.
Sworn to silence, yet burdened with prophecy.
Cloaked in shadow, feared by those who whisper her name.
Once a noble, now a blade for hire.
Blessed by moonlight, cursed by fate.
He bears the mark of the old gods.
She sees what others cannot—and never speaks of it.
Carries stories in scars and songs alike.
Trained in secrets, loyal to none.
Walks between worlds, but belongs to neither.
The last of a vanished order.
Doomed to wander until the stars align.
Speaks in riddles, but listens in silence.
His name is written in forgotten scripts.
Wears a crown of ash and iron.
She dances with spirits only she can see.
Carries a blade older than kingdoms.
His laughter masks a thousand regrets.
Was once a monster, now a martyr.
Guided by visions none believe.
Hides her face, but not her fury.
Bound by a vow he cannot recall.
Walks with wolves, speaks with wind.
Knows the cost of every secret told.
place: A ruin lost to time, where the wind still whispers warnings.
The last refuge before the end of the world.
Hidden deep in the mist, untouched by the sun.
Built on bones and bound in silence.
Once sacred, now stained by betrayal.
A floating isle that appears only under starlight.
Guarded by thorns and ancient magic.
Where dreams rot and reality bends.
A tower no one built and no one can enter.
Forever frozen, yet burning with unseen fire.
Where shadows move before the light.
A maze that remembers every footstep.
Buried beneath layers of lies and stone.
The sky breaks open above it every dusk.
No map dares mark its location.
Its stones hum with forgotten power.
The air is thick with memory and moss.
Night never ends within its walls.
A throne room without a throne.
Only the mad return from its gates.
A temple where no gods remain.
Its trees whisper names you’ve never spoken.
Echoes of battle still haunt its halls.
The stars vanish above it.
Built on the edge of forever.
thing: Forged from a fallen star and sealed with blood.
It hums when danger draws near.
An heirloom passed down by those who never die.
Its glow never fades, even in the deepest dark.
Etched with a language lost to all but the dead.
Drinks light, not reflects it.
Whispers secrets when held in silence.
Shattered once, yet whole again by will alone.
Heavy with power, and heavier with consequence.
Once a symbol of hope—now a harbinger of doom.
Slick with venom that never dries.
Coiled with intent, waiting to strike.
Sealed in a box no key can open.
A mirror that reflects only lies.
Breathes when no one is watching.
A relic tied to the fate of nations.
Sings softly when touched by moonlight.
It weeps when left alone too long.
Carries a curse older than names.
Twists the truth with every use.
Tasted the blood of kings and commoners alike.
Grown from stone, fed on sorrow.
Marks its bearer with unseen ink.
Shines only in the presence of evil.
Speaks in dreams, never in daylight.
